Package com.github.workerframework.datastores.fs

Class FileSystemDataStore

java.lang.Object
com.github.workerframework.datastores.fs.FileSystemDataStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
HealthReporter, DataStore, DataStoreOutputStreamSupport, FilePathProvider, ManagedDataStore
public class FileSystemDataStore extends Object implements ManagedDataStore, FilePathProvider, DataStoreOutputStreamSupport
This is a simple DataStore that reads and writes files to and from a directory upon the file system. The store directory must be an absolute path.

    • store

      public OutputStream store(String partialReference, Consumer<String> setReferenceFunction) throws DataStoreException
      Description copied from interface: DataStoreOutputStreamSupport
      Opens an output stream which the caller can use to store data. The data will be stored relative to the partial reference supplied. When the output stream is closed the supplied function will be invoked to return the reference which can subsequently be used to retrieve the data.
      Specified by:
      store in interface DataStoreOutputStreamSupport
      Parameters:
      partialReference - the partial reference, which the data will be stored relative to
      setReferenceFunction - the function which will be called to supply the reference for the data stored
      Returns:
      an open OutputStream which can be used for storing data
      Throws:
      DataStoreException - if the data store cannot service the request
